verdict.rationale: Salesforce ships an official, npm-installable `sf` CLI. Its non-interactive commands cover CI-style automation: creating scratch orgs, running data queries, running Apex tests, and creating/activating agents. Agentforce DevOps Center is pitched for build/test/deploy, and a community user calls the CLI passable with an easy deployment path. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of headless/non-interactive authentication (e.g., JWT or service credentials), documented CI pipeline integrations or examples, and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
